Three.js prompt: Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Render a fullscreen quad with an OrthographicCamera and a ShaderMaterial. In the fragment shader, output color = palette(sin(uv.x*10 + t) + sin(uv.y*8 + t) + sin(length(uv-0.5)*15 + t*2)) where palette() is a smooth RGB function of a single float. Pass time as a uniform updated each frame in the animation loop.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen quad + ShaderMaterial. In the fragment shader convert centered UV to polar (r = length, a = atan2). Compute u = 1.0/r + time, v = a/PI. Sample a procedural checker (step(0.5, fract(u*4)) XOR step(0.5, fract(v*8))) and darken by r so the center stays bright. Animate by adding time to u.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Create 2000 stars as a THREE.Points object with random XY in [-1,1] and Z in [-1,-100]. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial that raymarches an SDF combining 4 moving spheres with smooth-min: smin(a,b,k) = -log(exp(-k*a)+exp(-k*b))/k, k=8. Use a chrome-mercury palette: silvery blue-grey base, sharp white specular highlights, and a faint purple rim light on the dark side.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader: sample 3-octave value noise at uv*vec2(3,1) with y offset by -time*0.5. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. In fragment shader, take centered UV, apply rotation matrix with angle=time*0.3, scale by (1.5 + sin(time)*0.7). Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader raymarches an SDF that unions a sphere and a box with smooth-min, repeated infinitely with mod(p, 4.0)-2.0. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. 200 small ConeGeometry meshes (or a single InstancedMesh) acting as boids in 3D. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN plus EffectComposer. Render a rotating MeshNormalMaterial torus knot. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. PlaneGeometry 200x200 with 256x256 segments, rotated -PI/2 on X. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. 64 BoxGeometry bars in a row acting as a fake frequency analyzer driven entirely by math (no audio input). Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Plot the Clifford attractor x_next = sin(a*y) + c*cos(a*x), y_next = sin(b*x) + d*cos(b*y) with a=-1.4, b=1.6, c=1.0, d=0.7. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Place 1500 small CircleGeometry disks at polar (r, theta) = (sqrt(i)*spacing, i*137.5deg) for i in 0..1499. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Define a target shape as a polyline (e.g. the outline of the letter A). Compute its discrete Fourier coefficients. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Recursively pack circles using Descartes' Circle Theorem starting from 3 mutually tangent parents; recurse 6 levels deep. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Define a 2D analytic field, e.g. (sin(y) + cos(x*0.5 + t), sin(x) - cos(y*0.5 + t)). Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Generate a P3 (rhombus) Penrose tiling via deflation: start with a sun configuration of 5 thick rhombs and recursively subdivide 5 times.
